blocks.text: Glomerular filtrate mein sirf fuzlaat nahin balke zaroori ghizai madde (nutrients) bhi hote hain jinhen jism zaya nahin kar sakta. Selective reabsorption woh amal hai jis mein kaam ki cheezen renal tubule se wapas peritubular capillaries mein le jayi jati hain. Zyada tar reabsorption proximal convoluted tubule mein hota hai. Yahan filtrate ka taqreeban 75% pani osmosis se wapas capillaries mein chala jata hai. Glucose, amino acids aur namak (sodium, potassium aur calcium) active transport (tawanai laga kar) se proximal tubule se wapas khoon mein jate hain. Filtrate aage barhta hai to loop of Henle ki descending limb mein mazeed pani wapas liya jata hai. Ascending limb se pani nahin guzarta (impermeable), lekin yeh active transport se namak ko tubule se bahar nikalti hai. Distal convoluted tubule se bhi kuch pani aur namak jazb hote hain. Collecting duct pani wapas lene ki aakhri jagah hai.
